The test image shows a very young soybean seedling at the cotyledon stage emerging from wet, muddy soil. Key observations:
- Seedling at soil level with cotyledons just emerging
- A shriveled/rotted seed/cotyledon visible beside the main seedling
- Very wet, compact soil conditions
- Pre/post-emergence damping-off pattern

The Pythium reference collage is nearly identical — same wet muddy soil, same cotyledon-stage seedlings struggling to emerge, same rotting seed tissue alongside emerging seedlings.
